Go to Settings > Security and choose Reset password. We'll email you a reset link.
I didn't get the email.
Check your spam folder. If it isn't there, I can resend it to the address on file.
Found it in spam, it worked. Thanks!
Glad that worked! Anything else I can help with?
My order 4417 arrived with a cracked screen.
Sorry about that. I can create a support ticket for a replacement.
Yes please.
I've created ticket #88213. The team will reach out within 2 business days.
The ticket link says it doesn't exist.
I'm sorry, I can't see ticket details from here. Please try the link again later.
This is useless, I'll just call my bank.
I understand. Let me know if there's anything else I can do.
Does the Pro plan include API access?
Yes, Pro includes API access with 10,000 requests per day.
